title: Kevvu Keka
desc: Lakshmi's father does not approve of her relationship with her boyfriend, Buchi, as he is not rich. She then challenges him that Buchi will become a millionaire in six months.

title: Bheema
desc: Sekar admires Chinna and teams up with him to take over the streets of Chennai. However, things change drastically when Sekar falls in love and decides to change his ways.

title: Adhurs
desc: Twin brothers, separated at birth, grow up in vastly different environments. However, they are reunited when one gets kidnapped by gangsters.

title: Lucky Bhaskar
desc: A struggling bank teller takes a chance on a shady investment scheme with an unproven partner. Later, as his fortunes rise, so does his ego, driving him to take on increasingly reckless risks.

title: Vikram
desc: A special agent investigates a murder committed by a masked group of serial killers. However, a tangled maze of clues soon leads him to the drug kingpin of Chennai.

title: Kaakha Kaakha
desc: ACP Anbuselvan succeeds in killing a dreaded gangster but Pandya, the gangster's brother, kills Maya, Anbuselvan's wife. Later, Anbuselvan goes all out to finish Pandya and his gang.

title: Yentha Vaadu Gaani
desc: Sathyadev, an honest police officer, is on a mission to stop an organ trafficking racket, unaware that the mastermind is the same person who killed his beloved.

title: Fun Time
desc: The programme includes comedy clips from Tollywood movies.

title: Gauravam
desc: Arjun reaches his friend Shanmughan's village, only to find out that he has eloped with Pasupathy's daughter. So, Arjun, along with his friends and Yazhini, a lawyer, sets out to find the couple.

title: Seema Raja
desc: Seema Raja, the generous and carefree prince of Singampatti, becomes a responsible king and the saviour of his people after his grand-uncle reveals to him the history of his heroic heritage.

title: Gaddalakonda Ganesh
desc: A film-maker aspires to make a gangster movie and selects the hardened Gaddalakonda Ganesh as his subject. Soon, he and his friend put their lives on the line to follow Gaddalakonda's life.

title: Detective
desc: A brilliant detective investigating the murder of a dog unearths a far more sinister crime that he stumbles upon by accident.

title: Magadheera
desc: A kind-hearted young man falls in love with a beautiful woman. However, his life turns upside down after learning about his relationship with the woman from a previous birth.

title: Action
desc: Subhash, an army man, seeks vengeance when a conspiracy claims his loved ones. He investigates the plot and takes matters into his own hands, mounting a daring operation to capture the culprit.
